judged_text: In updateAllCalendarEvents, credential is declared once outside the per-reference loop and only reassigned when the in-memory filter or the DB lookup finds a match, so an unresolvable reference.credentialId leaves the previous iteration's credential in place when result.push(updateEvent(credential, ...)) runs. Rescheduling a multi-reference collective booking after one host deleted their calendar credential (or their credential row has no app slug) reuses the previous host's credential, attempting the update against the wrong user's Google/Microsoft account — 404ing on the mismatched uid/calendarId or mutating the wrong account — instead of failing that single reference.
